# Container images needed to run server-scan in an air-gapped environment.
#
# Generated by hand from the actual references in this repo (Containerfile,
# frontend/Containerfile, .github/workflows/ci.yml, deploy/helm/server-
# inventory/values.yaml, scripts/dev-up.sh) — not a copy of any vendor's own
# list. Re-check this file whenever one of those changes; nothing here is
# pulled from a manifest automatically. See docs/air-gap.md for the full
# mirroring instructions (PyPI/npm packages, not just images).
#
# Pin every tag to a real version before mirroring into a production
# registry — "9.8" means "whatever this repo currently points
# at", not a version identifier a mirror sync should be repeated against
# blindly. Re-run this list's images through your mirror whenever any of
# the source files above changes.

# --- 1. Application images (required — this is what you deploy) ---
# Published by .github/workflows/ci.yml's `publish` job on every push to
# main that passes CI (docs/adr/0010-image-publishing-and-versioning.md).
# The tag is `X.Y.Z` with NO leading `v` — docker/metadata-action's
# {{version}} strips it, so the git tag `v11.0.0` publishes `11.0.0`.
# Mirror the version the chart's `appVersion` names, not `latest`: with
# `pullPolicy: IfNotPresent` a node that already holds a `latest` layer
# never re-pulls it, so a mirrored `latest` freezes at whatever it first
# synced. `git tag --sort=-v:refname | head -1` on a connected machine, or
# the GHCR package page, gives the current release.
#
# The same API image also runs every collector CronJob
# (tools/run_collector.py --manager-type <TYPE>) — it is not a second
# image, deploy/README.md's "same image as the API ... so no second image
# is needed" is deliberate.
ghcr.io/team-redbull/server-scan-api:1.0.0        # match deploy/helm/server-scan/Chart.yaml's appVersion
ghcr.io/team-redbull/server-scan-frontend:1.0.0   # same

# --- 2. Build-time base images (only if you build these two images
#         yourself inside the air-gapped environment, rather than
#         mirroring the pre-built images in section 1 above) ---
# All four pull from Red Hat's registry, mirrorable via a standard Red Hat
# registry sync (`skopeo sync` or an internal Quay/Artifactory proxy)
# under the same subscription/EULA terms as any other UBI usage.
registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi-minimal:9.8       # backend runtime (Containerfile)
registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/nodejs-22:latest      # frontend build stage — discarded, not shipped (frontend/Containerfile)
registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/nginx-124:latest      # frontend runtime (frontend/Containerfile)

# --- 3. Platform-provisioned dependencies (required to run) ---
# MongoDB is the system of record; Redis is an optional cache-aside layer
# every read path degrades past on any failure. The Helm chart defaults to
# consuming a pre-existing Secret naming their URIs rather than creating
# either — pick your own production-grade images/versions and HA/backup
# strategy. The versions below are only what this repo's own local-dev
# stack (scripts/dev-up.sh) uses, offered as a known-compatible starting
# point, not a production recommendation.
docker.io/library/mongo:8              # local dev only — see deploy/README.md for why production Mongo is out of this chart's scope
docker.io/library/redis:8-alpine       # local dev only — same

# Only if you set `mongodb.enabled` / `redis.enabled` and let the chart
# bundle them (Bitnami subcharts, vendored under
# deploy/helm/server-scan/charts/). Bitnami's charts default the tag
# to `latest`, which is a development build since Bitnami's August 2025
# catalog change and is not mirrorable as a version — pin one explicitly
# (values.yaml shows how) BEFORE syncing, or the mirror holds a moving
# target. Version tags for the free catalog live under `bitnamilegacy/*`,
# frozen at August 2025.
#
# Confirmed 2026-09-08 against the actual vendored charts: 19.1.16
# (mongodb) and 28.0.15 (redis) were built against MongoDB 8.3.4 / Redis
# 8.10.1, neither of which the frozen legacy catalog carries — it tops
# out at 8.0.13 / 8.2.1. The tags below are the newest the free catalog
# has, offered as the practical choice, not a confirmed-compatible one —
# smoke test before trusting this pairing in production. Re-check
# hub.docker.com/r/bitnamilegacy/{mongodb,redis}/tags before mirroring in
# case a newer legacy tag has since appeared.
docker.io/bitnamilegacy/mongodb:8.0.13-debian-12-r0   # only with mongodb.enabled
docker.io/bitnamilegacy/redis:8.2.1-debian-12-r0      # only with redis.enabled
